formula: V_s = A₀ · (V₊ − V₋)   (en boucle ouverte, A₀ très grand)
sketch:
Observe: ampli op symbol with V+, V−, output, ±V_sat rails; student
wires it as follower, inverting, or non-inverting via a small preset
dropdown OR manually by dragging feedback resistors. Live scope
shows V_e (sine) and V_s superimposed; gain reads out from the slope
of V_s vs. V_e. Saturation clips the output when input exceeds
V_sat / G. Experiment: given a target gain G, pick R_1 and R_2 in a
montage inverseur. Evaluate: scope shows an unknown V_s(t); student
picks montage + resistor ratios that reproduce it. Wrinkle:
comparateur mode (open-loop) — output snaps to ±V_sat, a
qualitative jump to the logic-gate exercise.
